notes.title: BloodDome99 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello contestant! It's time for you to return to the BloodDome!

Thank you so much for playing BDC and helping to keep us motivated while we've worked on BloodDome99. As of today BloodDome99 is now live in Early Access and available for purchase on Steam. As a small thank you for all the support we will be offering a 20% discount for the first 7 days. Check it out and, if you want to support us, consider leaving a review! Reviews really help small developers like us reach more people.

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351890/BloodDome99?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=event&utm_campaign=eaLaunch&utm_content=bdcAnnouncement]Buy BloodDome99 on Steam[/url][/h1]

notes.title: SEASON 01 IS NOW LIVE [patch notes inside]
notes.content:
Hello contestants! Welcome to Season 01. Here's some important information you should know as you enter the new season

[h1]Major Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Supply Drones[/b]: Supply Drones now appear at regular intervals in all modes. Destroying them drops a power up which immediately triggers a level up, granting a new perk. The drones speed up as the game goes on, and the power ups disappear pretty quickly, so try to act quickly if you want to take advantage of them
[*] [b]Unlockable Palettes[/b]: Added over 35 unlockable palettes and color options. Palettes are unlocked by hitting certain TOTAL DOLLAR (the number of dollars earned across all your runs) milestones, unlocking achievements, or meeting certain hidden conditions
[*] [b]Bullet Heaven Mode[/b]: Aim and shoot automatically so you can play with only the WASD keys or single analog stick. Bullet Heaven mode is unlocked by earning a certain Steam achievement and scores are tracked on a separate leaderboard
[*] [b]Professional Mode[/b]: Allows you to pick from all the available perks every time you level up. Also adds some HUD overlays with additional information on damage, speed, enemy health, and more. Professional mode is unlocked by earning a certain Steam achievement and scores are tracked on a separate leaderboard
[/list]
[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[list]
[*] SPREADSHOT now reduces bullet size
[*] PASSIVE INCOME now increases movement speed
[*] SCORCHED EARTH now decreases enemy health and movement speed
[/list]
[h1]QOL and Other Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The perk screen now has a short animation when it appears, during which you cannot select a perk. This should help to reduce/eliminate accidentally choosing a perk by mis-click
[*] The perk screen now shows the number of times each perk has been chosen during the run
[*] The number of points put into Passive Income is now visible in the pause menu
[*] Added a leaderboard viewer to the Extras menu that allows viewing the leaderboard for any configuration of modes that you have played
[*] Fixed special characters (e.g. foreign alphabets) not showing on the leaderboard
[*] Some UI changes
[*] Console log: You can now toggle a console log with the ~ key. If you have any issues while playing please enable the log, take a screenshot of any errors posted there, and share it with us on Discord of the Steam Community page
[/list]

notes.title: BDC Season 01 update comings soon! And, BloodDome99 closed beta waitlist is open
notes.content:
First, I want to say thank you SO MUCH to everyone who has showed interest in BDC and provided feedback. BDC has now been claimed by over 60,000 people! If you haven't, please consider leaving us a review! Reviews really help small developers (like us) with visibility! It means a lot to us <3

Second, the BIG NEWS! BloodDome Classic is getting its first major update on September first.

[previewyoutube=K-7mLCiHB8k;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] 2 new game modes
[*] 35+ unlockable color palettes
[*] Supply Drones
[*] Balancing and QOL changes
[*] IMPORTANT NOTE: Season 00 scores will be ARCHIVED on September 01. They will be viewable via a new leaderboard viewer in the extras menu
[/list]


Lastly, we are starting a waitlist for the BloodDome99 closed beta. We will be accepting a limited number of playtesters on a rolling basis. Your feedback will help shape the final game, so it's important to us that applicants are enthusiastic about providing quality feedback. You can sign up here:

[url=https://discord.com/invite/9REkcpzKgV]BloodDome99 Beta Waitlist[/url]

NOTE: Joining the waitlist does NOT guarantee entry to the beta. We are only accepting a limited number of playtesters
